from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3d8e0950.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    colors = [c for c, n in counts.items() if c != bg and n >= 2]
    if not colors:
        return out
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    others = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg, color)]
    if not others:
        return out
    mr = sum(r for r, c in others) / len(others)
    mc = sum(c for r, c in others) / len(others)
    pairs = []
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2, c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r1 != r2:
                dr = 1 if mr < (r1+r2)/2 else -1
                dc = 1 if mc < (c1+c2)/2 else -1
                # Continue away from the remaining colored pattern.
                candidates = [((r1,c1),(r2,c2)), ((r2,c2),(r1,c1))]
                for start, end in candidates:
                    vr = 1 if end[0] > start[0] else -1
                    vc = 1 if end[1] > start[1] else -1
                    # A ray points away from the other-color cluster.
                    if vr == dr and vc == dc:
                        pairs.append((start, end, vr, vc))
    if not pairs:
        return out
    start, end, dr, dc = pairs[0]
    r, c = end[0] + dr, end[1] + dc
    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == bg:
        out[r][c] = color
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
